package.name: hhros2_core
package.description: System governance core (04_system_governance): the centralized safety state machine, control-mode arbiter and tiered diagnostics. Detects Level 1/Level 2 faults from heartbeats, IMU tilt and L0 status, and on a critical fault drives the safe reflex (switch to damping_controller and/or cut the L0 bus enable).
